releases.release_notes_markdown:
Cooked files added to a compressed pak file.

# installation:
Drag pak file into the TBL/Content/Paks folder in chivalry 2 root, or use the C2GUILauncher.

# usage:
This map depends on the HealthCharger mod. If that mods is not installed, then the asset will not appear in this map when it should.
